collection.title: Zebrafish larval nitrogen excretion is flexible and resilient to loss of rhesus glycoproteins
collection.authors: Mes, W.; Haanen, R.; Arshad, A.; Klaren, P. H. M.; Schaaf, M. J. M.; Faught, E.; Nakada, T.; van Kessel, M. A. H. J.; Gorissen, M.
collection.abstract: Nitrogenous waste excretion is essential for all developmental stages of fish. In zebrafish, ammonia excretion involves rhesus glycoproteins Rhbg and Rhcgb.
